## 📄 YouTube Description

In this episode of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*, host Bethany Gifford sits down with Margaret Stoch, founder of Advanced Therapy and Wellness Center in the Chicago suburbs, to uncover the often-overlooked root causes behind feeding difficulties, airway issues, sleep disorders, facial development problems, and chronic tension in both children and adults.

Margaret is one of the few providers in the country using a fully integrated approach that combines myofunctional therapy, speech pathology, occupational therapy, body work, and airway-focused care. Her work spans from infants pre and post tongue-tie release to adults dealing with TMJ, sleep apnea, orthodontic relapse, migraines, and facial asymmetry.

In this conversation, we explore:
• What myofunctional disorders actually are and why they matter  
• How breathing, swallowing, sleep, facial growth, and nervous system regulation are all connected  
• Why breastfeeding challenges are often the first red flag of deeper airway or structural issues  
• The role of tongue ties, lip ties, and fascial tension in facial development  
• How poor oral function leads to crooked teeth, jaw imbalance, and long-term health issues  
• What aesthetic practitioners should look for when treating TMJ, facial asymmetry, or chronic tension  
• Why treating symptoms without addressing root cause keeps patients stuck  
• How Margaret built a nationally recognized referral-based practice through collaboration and education  
• The importance of early intervention and whole-body care for lifelong health

This episode is a must-watch for:
• Parents navigating feeding, sleep, or developmental concerns  
• Aesthetic injectors, facialists, and providers treating TMJ, jaw tension, or facial imbalance  
• Wellness practitioners interested in airway health and root-cause care  
• Anyone experiencing chronic mouth breathing, snoring, sleep issues, or facial tension  

Margaret also shares what is next for her practice, including expansion, education initiatives, and her mission to empower parents and practitioners with knowledge that can change lives early.

Host of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*

Stay curious. Stay well. And keep evolving.
